question: Lamine Yamal, who won the Breakthrough of the Year award in 2025, plays which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lamine Yamal** is a world-renowned professional **Football** player from **Spain** who plays as a **winger**.
 
• In **2025**, he was honored with the **Laureus World Breakthrough of the Year** award, recognizing his extraordinary rise in the sport of **football** over the preceding year.
 
• He currently plays for the Spanish giant **FC Barcelona** and represents the **Spain national team** at the international level.
 
• Yamal gained global prominence during the **UEFA Euro 2024**, where he played a central role in leading **Spain** to their **fourth European Championship** title.
 
• He was awarded the **Young Player of the Tournament** trophy at **Euro 2024**, having recorded **four assists** and **one goal** during the competition.
 
• By winning the **Laureus Breakthrough** award, he joined an elite list of athletes who achieved global stardom at a very young age, often being compared to legends like **Lionel Messi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Early Career and La Masia**: **Lamine Yamal** was born on **July 13, 2007**, in **Esplugues de Llobregat**, **Spain**. He joined **La Masia**, the famous youth academy of **FC Barcelona**, at the age of seven, where he was quickly identified as one of the most promising talents in **football**.
 
• **FC Barcelona Debut**: He made his senior debut for **FC Barcelona** on **April 29, 2023**, against **Real Betis**. At **15 years, 9 months, and 16 days** old, he became the youngest player to ever play for the club's first team in **La Liga** history.
 
• **Kopa Trophy**: Prior to his 2025 Laureus success, Yamal won the **2024 Kopa Trophy** at the **Ballon d'Or** ceremony, an award given to the best performing **football** player in the world under the age of **21**.
 
• **International Impact**: He chose to represent **Spain** despite having heritage from **Equatorial Guinea** and **Morocco**. He became **Spain's youngest ever player and goalscorer** during a match against **Georgia** in **September 2023** at the age of **16 years and 57 days**.
 
• **Market Value and Influence**: By the age of **17**, his market valuation exceeded **150 million Euros**, making him one of the most valuable **football** players on the planet. His playing style is characterized by elite **dribbling**, **close control**, and a powerful **left-footed** shot from the right flank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Youngest Records**: **Lamine Yamal** holds the record for being the **youngest player** to ever feature in a **UEFA European Championship** final and the **youngest goalscorer** in the history of the tournament.
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards**: These awards are held annually to honor the greatest sporting achievements. The **Breakthrough of the Year** category specifically targets athletes who have made a significant leap in their career rankings or status.
 
• **2024-2025 Season**: During this period, Yamal became a permanent fixture in the **Barcelona** starting eleven, contributing to numerous victories in **La Liga** and the **UEFA Champions League**.
 
• **Youth Recognition**: He is the first player in history to be nominated for the **Ballon d'Or** while still being a **minor** (under the age of 18).
